sn56.20:1.1: Cattārīmāni bhikkhave tathāni avitathāni anaññathāni || katamāni cattāri || || Idaṃ dukkhan ti bhikkhave tatham etam avitatham etam anaññatatham etaṃ || || Ayaṃ dukkhasamudayo ti tatham etaṃ avitatham etam anaññatham etaṃ || || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodho ti tatham etaṃ avitatham etam anaññatham etaṃ || || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti tatham etam avitatham etam anaññatham etaṃ || || Imāni kho bhikkhave cattāri tatthāni avitathāni anaññathāni || ||
sn56.20:2.1: Tasmā ti ha bhikkhave idaṃ dukkhan ti yogo karaṇīyo || la-pa || Ayaṃ dukkhanirodhagāminī paṭipadā ti yogo karaṇī yoti || || Dhammacakkapavattanavaggo dutiyo || ||
sn56.20:3.0: Tassa uddānaṃ || || Tathāgatena dve vuttā || Khandhā Āyatanena ca || Dhāraṇāya dve vuttā || Avijjā Vijjā Saṅkāsanā Tathena
